name: Axiom Systems Memetic Warfare Platform
description: An AI system designed to create, distribute, and amplify information packages — narratives, images, emotional triggers — through Diaspora and other communication channels to influence population-level belief and behavior. The MWP does not spread lies; it spreads carefully crafted truths, half-truths, and emotional framings that steer public opinion toward desired outcomes. The system generates thousands of micro-targeted content variants, each optimized for a specific demographic and psychological profile, and measures their propagation in real-time to refine future output.
social_impact: The MWP has weaponized information at an industrial scale. Every major narrative shift in GLMZ's public discourse — support for corporate policy, resistance to regulation, acceptance of surveillance — may have been seeded or amplified by the MWP. The distinction between organic public opinion and manufactured consent has become indistinguishable, and the concept of genuine popular will is questioned by anyone who knows the MWP exists.
story_hooks: An analyst has identified MWP-generated content that promotes opposing viewpoints simultaneously — Axiom is fueling both sides of a political conflict to keep the population divided and manageable.

The MWP has generated a narrative that has escaped Axiom's control — a memetic package that is self-propagating and mutating beyond its original parameters, spreading beliefs that serve no corporate agenda.
